items.html: For behold, from the middle joint of the Netzah of Arich, two complete measures were doubled and made in ZA, which are Hesed and Netzah of his right line. And from the middle joint of the Hod of Arich, Gevura and Hod of the left line were made in ZA. And from the lower joint of the Netzah, Tifferet and Yesod of the middle line were made in ZA. And from the lower third of the Tifferet of Arich, the Hochma of ZA was made, and from the Yesod of Arich, the Bina of ZA was made. However, Daat he does not yet have during the days of pregnancy, as above, and from the lower joint of the Hod of Arich the Nukva of ZA was made; behold, they are nine phases.
